name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 证据撑不起的词，一个都不写进结论
tagline_zh: 分析完总想写「显著提升」「导致增长」？它把结论拆成观测→方向→可决策三档，没实验设计就禁止因果词。
tagline_en: Tired of conclusions overstating your data? It grades every claim: observed → directional → decision-support.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 不是查错字，是卡在推理链上：每个动词都得过证据载荷测试，撑不住就降档或删掉。
why_en: It doesn't proofread—it stress-tests each verb against your evidence. Claims that can't bear the load get downgraded or cut.
limit_zh: 只处理从分析结果到书面结论这一步，不碰数据清洗、统计检验或图表设计；且需要你提供原始分析输出或草稿。
limit_en: Only polishes analysis-to-prose conclusions; won't clean data, run stats, or design charts. Needs your raw output or draft—empty input yields only a.
title_en: Writes only claims your evidence can carry
